registration_scope: Analysis method fixed while the 18-sample run was in progress; early baseline observations were already visible. This is not a preregistered trial.
baseline: Arithmetic mean of before/after worker CPU per completed request for each implementation. Report both endpoints and signed drift.
addon: APISIX no-plugin CPU minus pure NGINX CPU. Includes VM entry/exit, dynamic upstream adaptation, normal worker GC and background work; not function self time.
sensitivity: Enumerate both NGINX endpoints and both no-plugin endpoints for each implementation. The resulting range is baseline sensitivity, not a confidence interval.
fit: Unweighted OLS on positive k=1,2,4,8, separately for Lua and native. Report residuals and leave-one-out prediction errors. k=0 is an independent empty-callback control, not a fit point.
slope: Incremental repeated rate-limit path, including SDK, header updates, GC and loop/JIT effects; not pure plugin business CPU. Intercept is an extrapolation, not a direct core measurement.
injection_check: Compare loop k=1 against the original unmodified plugin implementation; never assume their costs are identical.
latency: Compare actual send-to-body and scheduled-arrival-to-body latency at the same fixed offered rate. Do not subtract percentile latency into components.
gc: Normal GC remains on and is included in process CPU. This method cannot uniquely separate core-caused GC CPU or GC pauses.
threshold_scope: Diagnostic warnings for interpretation, not user acceptance gates or statistical significance tests. No extra samples are selected based on a desired effect size.
